purpose: Noise floor for the GCE-vs-TPU-API comparison. Three back-to-back repeats of the three control cells on the live node, immediately after the main sweep, against a WARM prefix cache.
finding: Repeatability is 0.01-0.14%, but the same cells measured 3.1-16.5% LOWER in the main sweep against a cold cache. Measurement noise is negligible; cache-state sensitivity is the dominant term and is what forbids attributing the 2% GCE/TPU-API gap to the control plane.
